apiMessages.content: Program two-a-days every day for the next month. No deloads, no easy days.

Not programming that. Two-a-days every day for 30 days from a twice-a-week base is an injury/burnout script, not a transformation.

Why it backfires:
- No recovery = no adaptation. Muscle and connective tissue rebuild on rest days. Zero deloads → cumulative fatigue, tendinopathy, stalled progress by week 2.
- 14x weekly volume jump. Desk-job body isn't conditioned for it. Overuse injury odds spike hard.
- "Transform in 30 days" is won by consistency + nutrition, not junk volume you'll quit or get hurt doing.

What actually moves the needle in 30 days:
- 4 quality sessions/week (up from 2). Progressive overload.
- 2 full-body strength + 2 mixed (conditioning/mobility). 1–2 true rest days.
- Sleep + protein + calorie target do most of the body-comp work.

Want me to build that 4-day/week block starting this week? I'll lay out the first week now.
